hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Hydraulic drive motors
function: The hydraulic motors on the injector frame that turn the drive chains, with a brake that holds the coil when the motors stop.

tabs.overview: Speed and torque set by the power pack flow and pressure; the brake holds against the snub or pull load when stopped.
tabs.engineering: Two or four motors per injector.
tabs.safety: Brake function tested before running; hot hydraulic lines.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
